correct_completion: he sent it to the manager.
full_sentence: Having finished his report, he sent it to the manager.
acceptable_variants: he then sent it to the manager.
he emailed it to the manager afterwards.

options.text: the manager had already left the office.
options.why_wrong: A participle clause must share its subject with the main clause, and here the main clause has no action that follows from the finished report.

options.text: he was sending it to the manager.
options.why_wrong: 'Having finished' requires a completed action before the main clause, so a continuous form does not fit.

options.text: he sent it to the manager.
to send the manager his report.
options.why_wrong: The infinitive phrase cannot function as a main clause that completes the sentence.

explanation: The perfect participle 'having finished' shows an action completed before the main clause, so the main clause must describe the next action by the same subject.
